data.name: Activity Recognition from Single Chest-Mounted Accelerometer
data.abstract: The dataset collects data from a wearable accelerometer mounted on the chest. The dataset is intended for Activity Recognition research purposes.

additional_info.summary:
--- The dataset collects data from a wearable accelerometer mounted on the chest
   --- Sampling frequency of the accelerometer: 52 Hz
   --- Accelerometer Data are Uncalibrated
   --- Number of Participants: 15
   --- Number of Activities: 7
   --- Data Format: CSV
additional_info.variable_info:
--- Data are separated by participant
   --- Each file contains the following information
       ---- sequential number, x acceleration, y acceleration, z acceleration, label 
   --- Labels are codified by numbers
       --- 1: Working at Computer
       --- 2: Standing Up, Walking and Going updown stairs
       --- 3: Standing
       --- 4: Walking
       --- 5: Going UpDown Stairs
       --- 6: Walking and Talking with Someone
       --- 7: Talking while Standing
